input.command:
for dir in /root/autodl-tmp/rsft_output_qwen3_8b_k1 /root/autodl-tmp/rsft_output_qwen3_8b_k1_s43 /root/autodl-tmp/rsft_output_qwen3_1_7b_k1 /root/autodl-tmp/rsft_output_llama_3_1_8b_k1; do
  echo "=== $(basename $dir) ==="
  if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
    ls -la "$dir"/
    for ckpt in $(ls -d "$dir"/checkpoint-* 2>/dev/null | sort -t- -k2 -n); do
      echo "  $ckpt:"
      if [ -f "$ckpt/adapter_model.safetensors" ] && [ -f "$ckpt/trainer_state.json" ]; then
        echo "    → complete"
      else
        ls "$ckpt"/ 2>/dev/null
        echo "    → INCOMPLETE"
      fi
      if [ -f "$ckpt/trainer_state.json" ]; then
        python3 -c "
import json
s = json.load(open('$ckpt/trainer_state.json'))
log = s.get('log_history', [])
last_loss = None
for e in reversed(log):
    if 'loss' in e:
        last_loss = e['loss']
        break
print(f'    epoch={s.get(\"epoch\",\"?\")}, step={s.get(\"global_step\",\"?\")}, max_steps={s.get(\"max_steps\",\"?\")}, loss={last_loss}')" 2>/dev/null
      fi
    done
  else
    echo "  DIR NOT FOUND"
  fi
  echo ""
done
